subject: Mutual close checklist — security handoff & DPA final items
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Preparing mutual close checklist for NovaBank — security/DPA items

Team —

Running the MAP for NovaBank and want to lock the security/compliance items we need to close before procurement signs. High level ask from the customer (Asha/Ravi): SOC 2 evidence timeline, completed SIG/CAIQ file, and DPA retention window confirmed for logs and customer data.

Proposed plan:
- We deliver final SOC 2 evidence pack and show internal controls doc by Mon 3/6.
- They complete SIG review and send back CAIQ by 3/9.
- DPA redlines: confirm 90-day logs retention + encryption at rest clause; they asked about an option for 180-day retention if regulated data appears.

Can Soojin lead the SOC 2 evidence pack and Karthik take point on the DPA redline? Marissa — can you prep the SIG workbook and tag items that require engineering signoff?

I'll coordinate the MAP milestones in HubSpot and propose a final sign-off call with Asha on 3/10.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP_novabank_outline.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preparing mutual close checklist for NovaBank — security/DPA items

Thanks Naomi — I reviewed the DPA redline Asha sent (attached). A few technical clarifications we should propose:

- Logs retention: we can commit to 90-day retention for debug/audit logs by default. For regulated customers needing 180 days, propose an addendum with a retention surcharge (estimate +12% MRC).
- Encryption: we have AES-256 at-rest and TLS1.3 in transit. For customer-managed keys we support KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS).
- Data deletion: we need to confirm whether NovaBank expects deletion of derived embeddings or if we can retain them for caching/perf reasons — suggest a policy note in DPA.

I attached a DPA_redline_v3.docx with inline comments for legal and product. I'll be available for a triage call Wed 3/8 11am PT to walk legal through the changes.

-Karthik
(attachment: DPA_redline_v3.docx)

From: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@novabank.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@novabank.com>
Cc: security@novabank.com
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 08:17:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Mutual close checklist — security/DPA items

Thanks Naomi/Karthik — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few points from our end after reviewing the redline: 

- 90 days sounds fine as the default. We will confirm whether we need 180 for some product workflows by Thu 3/9.
- Need explicit confirmation that audit logs include API request/response hashes (we don't need full payloads), and that PII is redacted in stored logs.
- SIG/CAIQ: I'm attaching the initial workbook — we filled the obvious items and flagged the 12 controls where we need technical evidence. Can Soojin/Marissa assess which are quick wins vs require engineering?

We can do the triage call Wed 3/8 at 11am PT. After that, target to finish SIG by 3/9 and have legal sign-off on DPA by 3/11.

Best,
Asha
Asha Gupta
Head of Platform Security, NovaBank
(attachment: SIG_CAIX_questions_20280307.xlsx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@novabank.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual close checklist — security/DPA items

Thanks Asha — I reviewed the SIG workbook and mapped items to owners. Quick summary: 

- 6 items are documentation-only (SOC2 control descriptions, encryption attestations) — I can compile the evidence by end of day Thu 3/9.
- 4 items need engineering proof (KV cache isolation, tenant separation tests, replay protection for streams) — Marissa, will you coordinate with infra to get short runbooks or screenshots?
- 2 items are legal/process (retention policy, subprocessors list) — Karthik/legal to handle.

I've attached a brief SOC2-evidence-plan.pdf that lists files we will hand over and where they live in the shared drive. For the API request/response hashes Asha mentioned: we retain only request/response metadata and a SHA256 hash of payloads; full payloads are not stored after 14 days unless specifically flagged for debugging. We can add PII redaction to that pipeline.

See you on the triage call.

-Soojin
(attachment: SOC2-evidence-plan.pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Gupta <asha.gupta@novabank.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual close checklist — security/DPA items

Quick update after the Wed triage:

- Engineering confirmed evidence artifacts for the 4 engineering items will be uploaded to the shared drive by Mon 3/13 (note: slightly outside the original MAP target; asked for a one-day buffer).
- Karthik: legal indicated the DPA redline is acceptable with two outstanding asks from NovaBank about retention and an option to request extended retention via addendum. Can you confirm the wording and whether we include pricing?
- Asha: can you confirm whether the 180-day option would be for all datasets or only certain regulated workflows? That determines addendum pricing.

If we can align on retention language today we can still aim for legal sign-off 3/11; otherwise we push procurement close to 3/15.

Naomi

Hi all —

We've confirmed internally: the 180-day retention will only be requested for a small set of regulated transaction logs tied to AML workflows. For all other datasets the default 90-day retention is fine. Please reflect this in the DPA addendum language and include a short pricing line item.

Asha — once you confirm the list of regulated datasets we'll finalize procurement. We are targeting a signed DPA by 3/15.

Thanks,
Ravi Patel
Director, Risk & Controls, NovaBank
